HNRS_native_stage_inputs: unchanged; consolidation only affects reported catalogs
reference_stream_rule: First4 big-endian bytes of SHA256 over compact JSON[hnrs-joint-alpha-v1,master,network_burst,actual generator recording ID,stream]; streams unit-shuffle/source-offset.
summary_convention: Seed-average within each recording, then recording means; precision pooled over calls. Three seeds are not independent recordings.
reference_conditions: Primary comparators are native population events; secondary region-aware catalogs use existing concurrent two-region attribution; no common added output filter/merge in primary scores.
nominal_score_caveat: Candidate tail scores are not calibrated recording-wide significance levels or human false-positive rates.
reference_scope: Synthetic-only current manuscript analyses; data generators and human data deliberately excluded.
